component.name: Grexa
component.summary: Fast Linux file content search with tabs, replace, and AI assistance

description.p: Grexa is a fast, precise grep-style search workbench for Linux developers. It feels at home on KDE Plasma, integrates with the Breeze icon set, and respects the system color scheme by default.
Highlights:

ul.li: Tabbed searches with per-tab state and isolated history
Text and regex search with culture-aware comparison
Content and Files result modes with sortable columns
Streaming results with cancellation and progress events
Safe atomic replace with capture-group support and same-filesystem temp files
Context preview with configurable before/after line counts
Docker and Podman container search with direct grep and archive mirror fallback
Optional AI Search chat with OpenAI-compatible endpoints
CLI mode with text / JSON / CSV output and shell completion

description.p: Security and reliability patch.

ul.li: Bound the regex replace scan per file (CPU deadline plus a match cap) so a pathological pattern can no longer peg a core on a large file, mirroring the search hot path's existing guards.
Removed hardcoded absolute build paths from committed config and docs.
Pinned the grexa-db git dependency to a release tag for reproducible builds and restored the cargo-deny policy check to green.

description.p: Smarter AI summaries.

ul.li: "Summarize results" now packs a few lines of context around each match — not just the matched line — with the hit flagged, so the assistant can answer about the surrounding code instead of an isolated line. The excerpt budget (Settings → AI Search) and the coverage notice still bound and disclose how much is sent.

description.p: Adds AI summaries of your search results.

ul.li: The AI Search panel gains a "Summarize results" button: it packs the on-screen matches (path, line, and matched text) into the model prompt — budget-bounded and breadth-first across files — so the assistant answers about what the search actually found instead of only suggesting filters.
Settings → AI Search adds an excerpt-budget slider that caps how much matched text is sent to the model.
Maintenance: the project now builds on the Rust 1.96 toolchain.

description.p: Fixes the GUI failing to launch.

ul.li: The database browser page used signal-handler names that did not match the controller's signals, which prevented the main window from loading. No other changes.

description.p: Extracted the flat-file storage engine into its own repository.

ul.li: grexa-db is now a standalone Apache-2.0 crate, consumed as a pinned git dependency instead of an in-tree workspace member. No user-visible change.
Hardened reference-path validation and view deletion in the storage engine.

description.p: Dependency refresh and secret-storage backend migration.

ul.li: Refreshed all third-party crates to their latest compatible versions.
Migrated API-key storage to keyring-core with the zbus secret-service backend; the same KWallet / GNOME Keyring storage, no user-visible change.
Reconciled the in-app Credits and Third-Party Licenses with the current dependency tree.

description.p: Reliability and localization patch.

ul.li: Hardened container search: per-command timeout and output-size limits with reliable process cleanup; large container searches report results as capped instead of failing.
Tighter search and replace resource bounds keep very large runs responsive.
Search status and notification messages are now fully localized.

description.p: Patch release.

ul.li: Skip the read-only-directory replace failure test when running as root, so CI passes in containerized release builds.

description.p: Localization, accessibility, and container hardening patch.

ul.li: Expose generic QML i18n helpers and migrate all qsTr() calls to Fluent.
Cache per-container grep availability in container search.
Honor the reduced-motion setting for all busy spinners.
Enforce the shared 512 MiB read cap in the replace pipeline.
Smoke-test the AppImage in release CI.

description.p: Patch release.
Search and replace hardening release.

ul.li: Add whole-word search matching.
Add CLI replace subcommand with full search flag parity.
Harden search/replace correctness: normalized offset mapping, capture expansion, and whole-word boundary handling.
Improve container search: flag forwarding, binary replace guard, and correct column offsets.
Cache GUI search options and deduplicate per-tab results.
Add accessibility settings and keyboard shortcuts.

description.p: Packaging fix release.

ul.li: Refresh the pinned linuxdeploy hash so the AppImage release artifact builds again. Carries the 1.4.0 changes: the full license texts for the bundled runtime components are now viewable in-app via Credits and the Licenses view.

description.p: Third-party licensing transparency.

ul.li: The full license texts for the system and runtime components Grexa builds on (Qt, KDE Frameworks/Kirigami, Poppler, the Docker/Podman CLIs, and the Secret Service backends) are now bundled and viewable in-app.
Credits gains a per-component "View license" action, and the Licenses view gains a searchable "Runtime components" tab alongside the existing Rust-crate bundle.

description.p: Application identity update.

ul.li: The application ID is now com.visorcraft.Grexa (desktop file, AppStream component, icons, D-Bus/Wayland app_id, and the Secret Service keyring), matching the visorcraft.com domain.
Breaking identity change: installations of earlier versions do not upgrade in place, and previously stored API keys are not carried over to the new keyring service.

description.p: Security hardening and cleanup release.

ul.li: The replace pipeline refuses to write outside the search root and restores file permissions through the file descriptor (no post-rename chmod window).
AI API keys are never transmitted over plaintext HTTP and are redacted from logs and debug output.
Bounded regex backtracking, a 512 MiB search read cap, and a pdftotext watchdog guard against pathological inputs.
Container exec/cp argument-injection hardening and CLI terminal-escape sanitization.
API keys use the pure-Rust Secret Service keyring backend.
Hardened release CI and removed dead code / unused deps.

description.p: Packaging refresh with expanded Linux release artifacts and hardened release CI.
v1.0 — stable release. Feature-complete against Grex on Linux.

ul.li: Promotes the v0.3 polish + responsiveness pass to a 1.0 line — per-tab result-row isolation, responsive action toolbar, auto-saved Settings, locale-aware pluralization, taskbar icon integration, About page "Licenses & Credits" card.
Stable on-disk schemas: settings.json, recent_paths.json, search_history.json, profiles.json, replace-journal.json all forward-compatible with v0.3. No data migration required.
All v0.3 known limits remain on the roadmap (Qt palette swap via KColorSchemeManager; structured-field path redaction in tracing spans).

description.p: v0.3 — polish, responsiveness, true per-tab isolation.

ul.li: True per-tab result-row isolation via a Rust-side snapshot store — switching tabs preserves the full result buffer + counters + within-filter state.
Responsive action toolbar — buttons wrap to additional rows instead of clipping when the window narrows.
Taskbar icon — the pink gecko now resolves correctly under Wayland / KDE Plasma via `setDesktopFileName` + auto-install of the user-local hicolor icon theme.
Settings auto-save — every input commits to disk on change; the Apply button is gone. A "Saved" pill fades in for visual confirmation.

UX cleanup: Filters toggle now closes the drawer on second click; Esc closes drawers when no search is running; Export menu toggles; re-clicking the active tab or nav item is a no-op (was a hidden side effect).

description.p: v0.2 — full GUI feature parity with Grex on Linux.

ul.li: Folder picker, filter drawer, target selector for Docker/Podman.
Replace flow with confirmation, residual journal recovery on startup.
Result row context menu, search-within-results, sortable columns, export to CSV/JSON/Markdown.
In-session search tabs (Ctrl+T / Ctrl+W).
Saved-search Profiles page and search History page.
Settings: Editor presets + custom command template, Accessibility (reduced motion, high contrast), Privacy (path redaction in logs), Replace (confirm + journal-on-startup).
Single-instance lockfile, KNotification on long searches and replace, keyboard shortcuts (F1, Ctrl+1..4, Esc, Ctrl+Q).

description.p: Initial alpha. Core Rust search engine, CLI, AI HTTP client, and container detection.
